text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: So all I gotta do is plug this hole, right?
choice_data_list: Huh? Did you buy a new curling iron?
Huh? Did you buy a new curling iron?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: No, it's the same as before.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Since I had the day off yesterday,
I took the time to maintain my gear.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
The more you use your tools, the better they fit your hands...
allowing for delicate, precise work.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"That is why I maintain it with great care,
so that it may serve me for as long as possible."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Thanks to that... it's very easy to use.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It seems Believe was able to spend her day off meaningfully.
